minutes.headline: Parks Commission let Special Olympics use Fitzgerald Field free for six weeks and backed McNally as a capital request.
minutes.summary: The commission heard staff updates, approved a fee-waived Special Olympics booking at Fitzgerald Field through November 5, and discussed capital plan priorities including McNally Field, t-ball and Fitzgerald. It also covered TCP gym programming, a beach house carpet-removal volunteer day, the Special Town Meeting warrant for the Marshall Park grant, the skate park delay and a new commissioner applicant. Meeting adjourned after a roll call.

budget_items.what_was_said: Staff asked to waive fees for a few Sunday-morning practice sessions; the commission agreed, noting no fee structure exists for short-term use.
Staff are getting pricing and building a maintenance plan to restore infields, working with a vendor who has specialized equipment.

budget_items.topic: TCP gym fee structure and revolving fund
budget_items.what_was_said: The town manager's office is working out how rental fees split between the revolving fund and building maintenance; past events at the building produced no revenue to the town.
A family event with a family maximum cap was posted and pricing was raised for discussion.
Commission to send a wish list of capital projects including McNally and Northfield Park; deadline unknown. Staff noted the Marshall Park project took a long time to spend funds once granted.

budget_items.topic: Marshall Park grant and town meeting appropriations
budget_items.what_was_said: The state grant contact wants a town meeting vote to appropriate the full project cost; funds were previously voted last year and ARPA funds are decided by the select board.

decisions.decision: McNally Field stays on the capital plan request list as a priority, with the t-ball field question left open pending Little League numbers.
Chair will note a revision of the field use policy to add special circumstances and let staff approve short requests without waiting for the commission.
Karen will lead a volunteer day to pull beach house carpet this fall; staff will supply a dumpster and handle cutting, with flooring in spring.
Chris to tell the commission the capital plan deadline when he learns it.
October 18 meeting to be held in person with a hybrid option, location Town Hall or the Ritter building to be confirmed.
Chair to email baseball about the skate park and ask to use the softball field at Fitzgerald for t-ball, and to request attending one of their meetings.

what_happened.line: The Parks Commission voted to let the Special Olympics use Fitzgerald Field for six weeks through November 5, 2023, with fees waived; the vote was not audible in the captions.
McNally Field stays on the capital plan request list as a priority, with the t-ball field question left open pending Little League numbers.
The chair will note a revision of the field use policy to add special circumstances and let staff approve short requests without waiting for the commission.
A volunteer day led by a commissioner will pull up beach house carpet this fall; staff will supply a dumpster, with new flooring in spring.
The state grant contact for Marshall Park wants a town meeting vote to appropriate the full project cost, and town counsel will finalize the warrant language.

why_it_matters: Fitzgerald Field had no fee structure for short-term use, so the fee waiver and the planned policy revision will set how groups that ask for brief bookings are charged.

McNally Field and other park projects compete for money through the town's capital plan, and the Marshall Park grant needs a Special Town Meeting appropriation that residents will be asked to vote on.
watch_next: The October 18 commission meeting, in person with a hybrid option, location to be confirmed.
The capital plan deadline, which staff are to report once known, and the Special Town Meeting warrant language for the Marshall Park grant.
